  "phoneNote": "Warm photography and readable typography work well, but the seven oversized opening-hours rows make the page unnecessarily long before visitors reach the products.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero feels polished and bakery-specific, but the oversized hours chart and narrow, left-aligned product list give the middle of the page an unbalanced, stretched-out layout.",

    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Replace the oversized opening-hours bars with a compact day-and-time table, grouping days with identical hours and keeping weekend hours separate.",
    "Arrange the desktop product categories in three balanced columns across the content width; retain the stacked menu on phones.",
    "Reduce desktop section padding and the blank band beneath the hero so the page moves more naturally from introduction to practical information."
